author: blu
body: Proves Wrath of God. "Destroy all creatures." compiles to DestroyAllCreatures; applying it sweeps every creature (both players') and leaves non-creatures (lands) alone. The AI scores a sweeper on the board differential: it is worth casting only when the opponent has more creatures than the caster (whose own board also dies), so control wraths when losing the board and holds it otherwise. This gives control the board reset it lacked.
